[P2] Cover non-string classification choices

Every classification fixture supplies a string `choice`, including the invalid-answer cases, so this rejecting branch has no test. It makes `{ type: "choice", choice: 42 }` produce `DeciderInvalidResponseError` instead of an accidental `StepError` from `trim()`. This violates CONTRIBUTING rule 4. Return to the validation/test design and require correctly discriminated answers with missing or non-string choices to reject with the advertised class through the real step boundary.
